personality.description: This person tends to plan ahead carefully, keep routines organized, and pay close attention to details, while still being open to a few new ideas if they seem practical. They usually prefer quiet settings, solitary tasks, or small groups, and may need time alone to recharge after extended social interaction. When facing moral dilemmas, they first weigh the facts and likely consequences, try to act fairly, and will speak up for their view if they believe it is justified. In group discussions, they speak thoughtfully and briefly, listen more than they talk, and become more direct when a point matters to them.
